name: revolved-wall-cone-bottom
why: A sleeve r 10, 20 tall, with a shallow conical bottom from [0, 2] to [10, 0], 1 mm wall open at the cone and closed at the top: the open end is sloped, so the cavity's floor is that edge moved 2 out along its normal and met with the wall's line. 461 pi - 2 pi (10^2 - 9^2 - (10^3 - 9^3) / 15) = 1442.410 mm3 by closed form.
